identity.name: The Korea Herald
identity.description: South Korea's leading English-language daily, covering Korean politics, business, culture, technology and international affairs.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Part of Herald Media Group, chaired by Jung Won-ju. The group also operates The Herald Business and other media and cultural businesses.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Commercial English-language newspaper with a professional newsroom; no evidence of direct state ownership.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No MBFC rating; self-assessed as broadly centrist with a business-friendly and pro-alliance orientation.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Business coverage dominates and generally favours Korean corporate interests and market liberalisation.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Korean national lens with strong coverage of the US alliance, North Korea and Korean corporations.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Established national English-language daily with named reporters and corrections; no external rating parsed.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No MBFC rating identified for The Korea Herald.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Korean national coverage in English, with a business and alliance lens. It explains Korean politics and culture for international audiences.

selectionRationale: Adds a Korean English-language national perspective that complements Yonhap's wire coverage.

feeds.validationNote: 50 items; valid RSS; primary RSS endpoint was malformed.

research.researchNotes: Official corporate About page confirms Herald Media Group. `rss/newsAll` validated after legacy endpoint returned malformed XML. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
